rule.name: ConstantIndexBeyondGuard
rule.message: This literal index is larger than the length the guard around it has proved. The guard lets through exactly the length at which the access throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException or IndexOutOfBoundsException (params.length > 1 ? params[2] : null, if (parts.length < 1) return; then parts[1]). Raise the guard to the index used (params.length > 2, parts.length < 2) or lower the index. Right code is not reported: a guard that admits the index (params.length > 2 ? params[2] : null), a receiver that is reassigned in the method, a variable index, and a receiver whose length is read in any other way before the access.
